I'd like to add EIP-8456 (CALLSTATUS) to the agenda as a late proposal for Hegota: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8456

It comes from community feedback on the Glamsterdam spec. 

After a failed call, contracts (try/catch, relayers, ERC-4337, Multicall) can't tell a real revert from an out-of-gas the sender forced, and the gasleft() checks they use break with each repricing. CALLSTATUS is a 2-gas instruction that returns whether the last call reverted or halted, independent of gas costs.

On the R&D pq-el chan we discussed doing an introductory call on leanVM, leanSPHINCS, leanXMSS, their status of development. The goal is to help clarify a lot of uncertainty around it and help client teams to prioritise better. So I would like to add exactly that to the agenda. Thanks @ilitteri for the suggestion 🙏. 

If time allows, I would like to present a 5 min introduction to the current state of leanSPHINCS expose the trade-off and ETA. I Invite my colleagues to do the same for leanVM, leanXMSS and leanPCS @TomWambsgans @tcoratger @kevaundray
I would like to discuss the addition of a new opcode allowing for introspection of the reservoir
